---
title: "HALO Readiness Simulation Report"
output: html_document
params:
  n_providers: 200
  n_days: 365
  schedule_type: "3/7 Day"
  rate: 0.1
  readiness_model: "exponential"
  readiness_half_life_days: 60
  readiness_threshold_days: 90
  training_program: "monthly"
  n_mc: 50
  seed: 42
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
library(halosimr)
p <- params
```

Simulation of `r p$n_providers` providers over `r p$n_days` days, `r p$schedule_type`
schedules, HALO events at `r p$rate`/day, `r p$readiness_model` readiness.

```{r single-run}
sched <- generate_schedule(p$n_providers, p$n_days, p$schedule_type, seed = p$seed)
ev    <- generate_events(p$n_days, rate = p$rate, seed = p$seed)
sim   <- hsrun(halo_sim(
  sched, ev,
  readiness_model = p$readiness_model,
  readiness_half_life_days = p$readiness_half_life_days,
  readiness_threshold_days = p$readiness_threshold_days,
  training_program = p$training_program, seed = p$seed
))
sim
```

## Single run

```{r single-figs}
plot_readiness(sim)
plot_gap_distribution(sim)
plot_exposure_histogram(sim)
```

## Monte Carlo (`r p$n_mc` runs)

```{r mc}
mc <- hsrunmc(
  n = p$n_mc,
  schedule_fn = function(s) generate_schedule(p$n_providers, p$n_days, p$schedule_type, seed = s),
  events_fn   = function(s) generate_events(p$n_days, rate = p$rate, seed = s),
  readiness_model = p$readiness_model,
  readiness_half_life_days = p$readiness_half_life_days,
  readiness_threshold_days = p$readiness_threshold_days,
  training_program = p$training_program
)
mc
plot_mc_band(mc)
```

```{r sweep}
thresholds <- seq(7, p$n_days, by = 7)
all_gap <- unlist(mc$gap_max)
sweep <- data.frame(
  threshold = thresholds,
  pct_exceeding = vapply(thresholds, function(t) 100 * mean(all_gap > t), numeric(1))
)
knitr::kable(sweep[sweep$threshold %in% c(30, 60, 90, 180, 365), ],
             row.names = FALSE, digits = 1,
             caption = "Percent of providers whose maximum gap exceeds each threshold")
```

customise.*
